instrumental of compound dakṣa-pāṇi indicating means

items.question: By what manual procedure must the consecrated water be secured after mantra recitation?
premises: The consecrated water is taken into the left hand.
The right hand serves as the instrument of covering.
Covering the held water is prescribed as the required action.
items.inference: Therefore, after recitation the consecrated water must be held in the left hand and covered with the right hand.
items.plain_english: Having taken it in the left hand, one should cover it with the right hand.
